models.name: carrier.postcode
models.sql:
SELECT waybill_id,
       receiver_zip_old AS postcode_zip,
       city_id
FROM waybills

models.name: carrier
models.sql:
WITH postcode AS (
  SELECT waybill_id,
         receiver_zip_old AS zip
  FROM waybills
  WHERE receiver_zip_old IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT waybill_id, zip
FROM postcode

models.name: dwd_delivery_fact
models.sql:
SELECT c.zip AS carrier_zip,
       p.postcode_zip
FROM carrier c
JOIN "carrier.postcode" p ON c.waybill_id = p.waybill_id
WHERE c.zip IS NOT NULL
